notes.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, seekers of the darkest stories![/h2]

We're excited to share that our friends' new title, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463980/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Purgatory/]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory[/url], is out now![/b]

Follow Samira, an Afghan werewolf and refugee, as she navigates both supernatural and human challenges in her quest for survival.

[h3]🐺 About Werewolf The Apocalypse – Purgatory:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]A new perspective[/b] – explore Samira's inner conflicts through a story-rich roleplaying game as she battles between rage and despair as an Afghan werewolf and refugee.
[*] [b]Thrilling conspiracies[/b] – uncover the supernatural secrets of the werewolves’ world through two distinct story paths, each offering different challenges and consequences.
[*] [b]Be the werewolf[/b] – intimidate, manipulate or when all else fails, decimate all that stands in your way.
[*] [b]Tabletop RPG meets visual novel[/b] – experience a blend of narrative-driven gameplay and tabletop RPG mechanics.
[*] [b]Legendary World of Darkness lore[/b] – based on the new fifth edition corebook mechanics, the game emulates a classic role-playing experience.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=TaEmz3Xkui4;full][/previewyoutube]
This edition not only continues the rich narrative tradition of its predecessors but also incorporates the innovative features of the [b]Werewolf: The Apocalypse Fifth Edition[/b]. This adaptation enhances gameplay, deepening your engagement with the lore and mechanics.

Whether you’re struggling against despair or raging against fate, your choices will carve Samira’s path through the game. Uncover supernatural conspiracies, battle the chaotic forces of the [i]Wyrm[/i], and navigate the haunting streets of Warsaw.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463980/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Purgatory/]Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Purgatory[/url] welcomes both seasoned World of Darkness veterans and newcomers alike. [b]No prior knowledge of the story world or Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest is needed.[/b] The game includes familiar characters and settings, enhanced with helpful pop-ups for new vocabulary that offer pronunciation tips, definitions, and lore to deepen your immersion.

We hope you'll enjoy the story!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463980/Werewolf_The_Apocalypse__Purgatory/

notes.title: Paradise Lost dives into a mysterious hidden city beneath an old Nazi bunker
notes.notes:
Abandoned bunker spelunker Paradise Lost sends you down underground in an alternate history 1980. The Nazis dropped nuclear bombs across Europe at the end of World War 2, leaving behind no winners and an apocalyptic wasteland. This narrative exploration game follows a young boy named Szymon down into an old bunker that looks like a bunch of old warheads and computers until he uncovers the hidden city packed with Slavic mythology beneath it. Paradise Lost has just launched today so you can venture down below right now.

notes.title: The Last Story on Earth Series begins today!
notes.notes:
Today we’re opening the vault to Paradise Lost’s ‘Last Story on Earth Series’. WWII went very differently in Paradise Lost than the events we know from our timeline. The documents in the vault will help to paint a more detailed picture of the alternate world you’ll find yourself in when you play Paradise Lost. Plus, it doesn’t hurt to have some interesting content to keep you occupied until the game comes out!
 
[previewyoutube=M4IWyCsshHE;full][/previewyoutube]

The series will consist of a variety of historical documents that will be released every Monday and Thursday. Each document will shed some light on the mysterious events that lead to the nuclear wasteland that Paradise Lost takes place in. 
Some of the types of documents found in the vault are: 
[list]
[*]International newspapers
[*]The personal letters and notes of people involved in various historical events
[*]Military reports
[*]Resistance intel
[*]The underground newspaper of the Polish resistance 
[*]And more!
[/list]

notes.notes:
It's finally here! The demo version of Paradise Lost will be available for 6 days—from June 16 19:00 CET to June 22 19:00 CET—as part of Steam’s Summer Game Festival. During that time, you’ll be able to begin exploring the desolate world of Paradise Lost and start on the journey through a mysterious, abandoned Nazi bunker.

Head to the game's Steam page and download the demo:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/982720/Paradise_Lost/

Depending on the path you take in the demo, you’ll be able to explore different areas. There will be two main paths to choose from. You’ll have the opportunity to learn more about the inhabitants of the bunker by examining items they left behind and to start forming theories as to what was happening the last time people were in the Nazi complex. By choosing one path or another, you’ll discover different memories left behind. 

Play the demo today and begin to discover the story hiding in the shadows of the past.

Want to learn more about Paradise Lost? Watch our new gameplay trailer and gameplay commentary video here:

Paradise Lost - Gameplay Trailer
[previewyoutube=M2Go0nWTeY0;full][/previewyoutube]

Paradise Lost - Gameplay Commentary
[previewyoutube=XQaTXpI0Eq4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]An Alternate History Timeline[/h3]
In an alternate version of WWII, the war dragged on for 20 more years only to end in flames when the Nazis launched nuclear missiles at most of Europe. In the aftermath, the heart of Europe remains shrouded in the mystery of complete destruction and deadly radiation, inaccessible to the rest of the world.

[h3]The Shadows of the Past[/h3]
You are a 12-year-old survivor, wandering the barren, nuclear wasteland of Poland, looking for hope, when you come across a massive, abandoned Nazi bunker. 

Descend into the bunker and find advanced industrial technology intertwined with mysterious Slavic pagan imagery. Make decisions that will shape your future as you work to uncover the secrets of the past and discover what happened to the bunker’s inhabitants.
